profiles.name: Stone Warder

constraints.summary: A stone warder must select an earth-themed bloodline (deep earth, copper dragon, earth elemental, orc, or shaitan).

evidence.section: Blood of the Earth / Power of Stone / Rune of Warding
evidence.reason: Blood of the Earth / Power of Stone / Rune of Warding defines the material change from the Sorcerer baseline.

profiles.playerSummary: Stone warders have an innate ability to create runes that allow them to ward areas with magic traps built from their spells. These sorcerers are most common among dwarves, but have been known to appear among other races who have strong ties to earth, rock, stone, mountains, and the Darklands.
profiles.tradeoff: It replaces or alters Eschew Materials; 3rd-level Bloodline Spell; 7th-level Bloodline Feat; those base-class tools are exchanged for the archetype’s more specialised package.
